children: , a leading direct-selling and e-commerce company that markets premium quality personal care, wellness, and “quality of life” products under the NHT Global brand, today announced the Company will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time. Chris Sharng, Natural Health Trends’ President, and Scott Davidson, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will host a conference call to discuss the third quarter 2026 financial results on the same day at 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The details for the conference call can be found below.
Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call
11:30 a.m. Eastern Time / 8:30 a.m. Pacific Time
For those unable to participate during the live broadcast, a replay of the call will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://ir.naturalhealthtrendscorp.com.
